title: Crowbound #3
desc: Ava Lee shouldn't be here. Trapped in the Factory Men's caravan, being transported across the swamplands. Ava Lee never did anything wrong. She was supposed to have one more year with her momma. But she'll get that year back, and more, if Rose has anything to say about it... The dark fantasy hit from JEFF LEMIRE and DUSTIN NGUYEN rolls on!
